completion_body: 'This issue has been completed in Pi Dash: <WEB_URL>/<workspace.slug>/projects/<project_id>/issues/<issue.id>' (WEB_URL or APP_BASE_URL setting; missing both raises ImproperlyConfigured)

guards.created_save: created=True -> return (imported mirrors are not transitions)
guards.missing_sync_row: no GitIssueSync and no GithubIssueSync for the issue -> return
guards.non_completed_state: state is None or state.group != 'completed' -> return

ordering: GitIssueSync checked first; only if absent is GithubIssueSync checked (github_signals.py:61-72)

post_completion_comment_tasks.error_shape: metadata['completion_comment_error'] = '<Type>: <msg>'[:500] or str[:500]; credential-missing short-circuits before HTTP

prior_capture: pre_save stores Issue.state_id into instance._git_sync_prev_state_id (None for new rows or vanished rows)
